summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the structure of conversion data. It was confirmed that a new page/section exists for conversions, which is intended to receive converted metrics.

Technical points covered included:
*   Whether 'sensor restriction' should be applied in both conversions and traffic tracking (it was suggested it belongs in conversions).
*   The UI component (combobox) needed for the conversion section must align with parameters. The user noted difficulty making this alignment automatic.

Regarding next steps, one participant took ownership of completing the UI development for the conversions section, while the other would focus on data preparation.
decisions: The new Conversion page will be used to consolidate conversion metrics.
action_items: One participant will complete the UI implementation for the conversions section.
The user will work on preparing and managing the necessary conversion data.
